head: 8ec13e8394777727e91618a2c44308a9929cfebe
scope: Refactor all in-scope SCM/Ouroboros parity and research-derived workflow/token-saving capabilities into one canonical Go implementation in sentra-code-memory-v2. Preserve local multi-worker, stamp/hash warm refresh, bounded queues, and offline lexical behavior. Implement phases 0-5 only; defer hosted sync, Postgres tenancy, remote overlays, and cloud deployment.
non_goals: Phase 6 hosted sync, Postgres tenancy, remote overlays, source-bundle cloud storage, Celery/S3/AWS deployment
Preserving standalone Rust or Python runtime seams
Mandatory network providers or hosted inference for local code workflows
risks: Large scope may cause broad regressions or drift across staged changes
Tree-sitter/LSP/SCIP integration may add native/toolchain complexity
Hybrid retrieval and local models may threaten latency or memory budgets
Session memory and event projections may leak source or stale context
HTTP/MCP surfaces enlarge the public contract
Frequent squash merges require careful base/head and cleanup verification
